description: Check pump.fun wallets by address: what each has been since day one, its class by rule (winner: took out more than it put in over 20+ coin-weeks; bot: a coin traded 20+ times in a week or 500+ coins; supply_seller: took out 1.5x what it put in, 100 SOL or more; new: no record before the mint you name, or before today) and the numbers behind it: pnl_sol, put_in, took_out, coins, first_seen. For: who is buying this coin, is this wallet a bot, a wallet's PnL, a holder check on the top buyers. Up to 50 addresses a call. $0.01 a call, USDC on Solana over x402, or a free key.

mint.description: optional: the coin they are buying; a wallet with no record before its creation is 'new'

payment.description: the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value for this exact call (USDC on Solana). Leave it out to get the offer: the price, the payee and the network come back as the error content and as _meta['payment-required'].

name: wallet_records
